name: ens-v1
status: frozen before the second annotator's (FL_NG) export was delivered or opened
rule: per file and axis: geometric mean of (a) ResNet-18 (ImageNet init) fine-tuned on FL_SA's counts, 5-fold CV grouped by the 44 fabric groups (paper/tables/fabric_groups_v2.csv), out-of-fold predictions, train_cv.py settings of label_day's base config, 15 epochs, seed 0; and (b) GPT-6.1-sol P1 frozen predictions (h = gpt-6.1-sol__v, v = gpt-6.1-sol__h); GPT missing -> CNN
honesty: POST HOC: the rule was chosen after scoring candidates against FL_SA's counts (FL_SA: ens-v1 25.5% vs GPT-6.1-sol P1 28.8%, paired -3.2 [-5.4, -1.0]; CNN component 28.3%; also tried: snapping the spectral counter to the CNN's octave, 32.1%). The CNN component was TRAINED on FL_SA's counts (out of fold by fabric). Results against FL_SA are therefore post hoc and in-sample for the rule choice.

primary_test.reference: FL_NG alone (per-scene labels of the second annotator; never seen when this file was written)
primary_test.script: methods/octave/eval_octave_v1.py --labels <FL_NG labels_per_scene.csv> --names FL_NG --reference each --pred methods/ensemble/predictions_ens_v1_150.csv (the --pred method is printed under the label 'octave-v1')
endpoints: share of scenes with both axes within 5%
paired dMAPE ens-v1 minus GPT-6.1-sol P1, scene bootstrap 10,000, seed 20261012, 95% CI; success if the CI excludes 0 in favour of ens-v1
secondary: the same against the mean of both annotators
the CNN component alone (--pred cnn_fabric_oof_FLSA_150.csv) vs GPT
